guess.text: Tell your teacher one thing that is true and one thing that is false.

Describe an animal without saying its name.
Ask your teacher to guess how old you were in your favourite memory.

opinion.text: Ask your teacher one question about their childhood.
Ask your teacher if they have ever broken a bone.
Ask your teacher what their favourite season is, and why.
Ask your teacher about their favourite holiday memory.
Give your teacher a genuine compliment.
Tell your teacher one thing you're excited to do this weekend.
Ask your teacher for one piece of advice.

imagine.text: Ask your teacher what superpower they would choose.

challenge.text: Make your teacher laugh in under one minute.
Teach your teacher how to do something.
Act out an animal and let your teacher guess which one.
Describe today in exactly three words.
Sing one line from your favourite song.

funny.text: Teach your teacher one Korean word.
Tell your teacher your funniest dream.
Invent a new word and explain what it means.
